title: 第四十六章 神魂结共生死生无别离第四十五章 龙根护圣血逆命抵天诛
lines: 二重灭脉劫碎，天地余威未散。
摄政王府庭院落满细碎灵光碎屑，空气里还萦绕着天道冰冷霸道的规则气息。
萧聿辞怀抱依旧稳固，可肩头微沉、气息虚浮，方才强行催动本命龙根，损耗的是万载难修的帝王本源，根基已然留下不可逆的暗伤。
唇角那抹猩红血迹，刺得沈清鸢双目发红。
她抬手轻轻抚上他的胸口，指尖颤抖，圣脉柔光源源不断送入他体内，想要修补他受损的龙根本源，嗓音带着压不住的哽咽：“傻子……真的是傻子。”
万古天道劫罚，本是她一人的宿命。
他却硬生生，将她的半世天罚、万载宿命，全数扛在了自己肩上。
萧聿辞低头，抵着她的额角，呼吸微沉，却依旧笑得温柔：“能护你，便不亏。”
可话音未落！
九天虚空骤然炸裂！
滚滚劫云疯狂翻涌、叠压，暗沉天幕黑如墨漆，压得整座山河寸寸窒息。
经历两重天劫连败，万古天道彻底震怒，不再循序渐进，直接引爆第三重——碎魂天劫！
这是九重劫中最阴狠、最诛心的一重！
不毁肉身、不封血脉，专碎神魂、灭执念、断羁绊！
天道早已洞悉二人最深的软肋——情深羁绊，生死相依。
它要碎的，是他们相融的执念，共生的心神，要让他们从此神魂撕裂、两两相残、永世相离！
轰隆隆——！
漫天漆黑劫光化作万千碎魂利刃，穿透虚空屏障，精准锁死庭院中相拥的两人。
刺骨撕裂的神魂剧痛瞬间席卷识海，比肉身碎骨之痛痛上百倍！
沈清鸢身形剧痛痉挛，眼前阵阵发黑，识海仿若被万千利刃反复切割，神魂摇摇欲裂。
萧聿辞本就龙根重伤、本源空虚，此刻再遭碎魂劫冲刷，喉间腥甜再度暴涨，整个人踉跄半步，硬生生将所有狂暴劫力，又挡去大半。
沈清鸢心头大恸，再也不愿让他独自硬扛。
她清楚，再这样单方面守护，只会两败俱伤。
暗处的血色残魂疯狂加持天劫力量，阴冷笑声响彻虚空：
“碎魂劫专破情爱执念！”
“我倒要看看，你们的情深义重，能不能扛得住神魂俱裂！”
“碎了你们的羁绊，断了你们的相依，我看你们还怎么逆命破轮！”
他藏在天道盲区，借天劫之力不断淬炼残魂，一边借刀杀人，一边坐收神魂溢散的灵气壮大己身，算计歹毒至极。
天罚压身，暗处偷袭，前路绝境无双。
可绝境之中，最璀璨的逆命神迹，骤然绽放！
沈清鸢强忍神魂撕裂之痛，抬眸死死望着身前护她的男人，眼底决绝滚烫。
“天道想碎我们羁绊？”
“想断我们死生？”
content_en:
The second level of destruction has shattered the pulse, and the remaining power of heaven and earth has not dissipated.
The courtyard of the Prince Regent's Palace was filled with fine debris of spiritual light, and the air was still filled with the cold and overbearing rules of heaven.
Xiao Yuci's embrace was still firm, but his shoulders were heavy and his breath was weak. He had just forced his natal dragon root to activate. What he had lost was the emperor's origin, which was difficult to repair for thousands of years. The foundation had already been left with irreversible hidden damage.
The scarlet blood stain on the corner of her lips made Shen Qingyuan's eyes turn red.
She raised her hand and gently touched his chest, her fingertips trembling, and the soft light of the holy veins was continuously sent into his body, trying to repair his damaged dragon root. Her voice was choked with uncontrollable sobs: "Idiot... really a fool."
Eternal calamity and punishment from heaven were her destiny.
But he forcefully carried her half-life punishment and ten thousand years of destiny on his shoulders.
Xiao Yuci lowered his head and pressed it against her forehead, breathing heavily, but still smiling softly: "It's no loss if I can protect you."
But the words have not yet finished!
The nine-day void suddenly exploded!
The rolling clouds of calamity surged crazily and piled upon each other. The sky was as dark as ink, and the entire mountains and rivers were suffocated inch by inch.
After experiencing two consecutive defeats of the Heavenly Tribulation, Eternal Heavenly Dao was completely furious. He stopped proceeding step by step and directly detonated the third level - the Soul-Shattering Heavenly Tribulation!
This is the most vicious and heart-wrenching level among the nine levels of calamity!
Not destroying the body, not sealing the bloodline, only breaking the soul, destroying obsessions, and breaking bonds!
Tiandao has already understood the deepest weakness of the two - their deep love and dependence on each other for life and death.
What it wants to break is their obsession with compatibility and their symbiotic mind. It wants them to be torn apart from each other, to destroy each other, and to be separated forever!
Rumble——!
The dark light in the sky turned into thousands of soul-crushing sharp blades, penetrating the void barrier and accurately locking the two people embracing in the courtyard.
The bone-piercing and tearing pain in the soul instantly swept through the sea of ​​consciousness, a hundred times more painful than the pain of shattering the bones of the body!
Shen Qingyuan's body was in severe pain and convulsions, his eyesight turned black, his sea of ​​consciousness seemed to have been cut repeatedly by thousands of sharp knives, and his soul was shaking to the point of splitting.
Xiao Yuci's dragon root was seriously injured and his origin was empty. At this moment, he was washed away by the soul-shattering calamity. The sweetness in his throat surged again. He staggered half a step and blocked most of all the violent calamity.
"Yu Ci!!"
Shen Qingyuan was filled with grief and no longer wanted to let him carry it alone.
She knew that if she continued to protect her unilaterally like this, both sides would suffer.
The bloody remnant soul in the dark crazily increases the power of the Heavenly Tribulation, and the cold laughter echoes through the void:
"The Soul-Breaking Tribulation is designed to break the obsession with love!"
"I want to see if your deep love and righteousness can withstand the heartbreak!"
"If your bond is broken and your dependence is broken, let me see how you can go against your fate and break the wheel!"
He hides in the blind spot of the heaven, and uses the power of the heavenly tribulation to continuously temper the remaining soul. While killing people with a knife, he absorbs the spiritual energy spilled from the soul to strengthen himself, and his plans are extremely vicious.
God's punishment is pressing down on you, sneak attacks from the dark, and the road ahead is in a desperate situation.
But in the desperate situation, the most brilliant destiny-defying miracle suddenly bloomed!
Shen Qingyuan endured the pain of tearing her soul and raised her eyes to look at the man protecting her in front of her, her eyes burning with determination.
"Does Heaven want to break our bond?"
"Want to end our life and death?"
title_en: Chapter 46: Soul and spirit knot, life and death, inseparable Chapter 45: Dragon root protection holy blood defies fate and is punished by heaven
